description: LANSING, Mich. — Yesterday, Sen. Chedrick Greene (D-Saginaw) joined the Michigan Senate in passing Senate Bill 278 to increase avenues for affordable housing. The bill will expand eligibility for the Michigan Housing and Community Development Program to include middle-income Michiganders. “With ever-increasing housing costs, it’s getting harder and harder for people with a solid job and good pay to find a quality place to live,” said Sen.
